hook.name: SwapFeeHook
hook.description: The single shared Uniswap v4 hook for all pools on the gwei.fun launchpad. It charges a platform fee plus optional per-pool creator buy/sell taxes on each swap's specified currency, minting ERC-6909 claims for lazy redemption by token creators and the GWEI buyback vault. An optional anti-snipe launch tax decays linearly to zero over a configurable window.
